source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
notes: The distribution of temporal adverbs also supports the analysis of (59a) as involving a zero allomorph of –DI substituting for the feature [immediate past]. The range of adverbs that can be used with adjectival immediate past tense using the zero allomorph is the same as with verbal immediate past tense using –DI.
en: Today at three o’clock I was slow.
